description: Create a discount code for a managed community. Business and community refer to the same thing and are interchangeable. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

code.description: Discount code that customers enter at checkout.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

isActive.description: Whether the item is active immediately.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Asia/Singapore.

type.description: Type value; use one of the allowed values in this schema.

value.description: Discount value: a percentage or a fixed amount, depending on the discount type.

name: create_business_discount
title: Create Business Discount
